themes.label: AI-driven disinformation undermining free speech
themes.definition: AI used to mass-produce lies and convincing falsehoods, manipulate public debate and democratic processes, framed as a betrayal of freedom of expression.
themes.inclusion: Passages on AI-driven disinformation, propaganda, manipulation of democratic processes, or deception at scale.
themes.exclusion: Disinformation discussions that do not reference AI or automated tools.
themes.boundary_cases: Online conspiracy theories without AI mention are context only; code when AI is named as enabler.

examples.quote: To distort free speech into the mass production of lies, propaganda, or AI-driven disinformation is not the exercise of freedom. It is its betrayal.
It is also making it easier to produce convincing falsehoods and manipulate public debate.

themes.label: Faster international cooperation on AI
themes.definition: Calls for governments, scientists and businesses to cooperate internationally, and quickly, to harness AI benefits while confronting risks.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging international multi-stakeholder cooperation on AI.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Harness benefits while confronting risks' also signals duality; code governance when a cooperative call is made.

examples.quote: Governments, scientists, businesses must cooperate internationally to harness the benefits of AI while confronting its risks, and we need to move faster.

themes.label: AI changing work and communication
themes.definition: AI described as a transformation changing how people work, communicate and receive information.
themes.inclusion: Passages describing AI's broad societal transformation of work and communication.
themes.boundary_cases: If work is mentioned only as part of a broad transformation list, still code here briefly.

examples.quote: This revolution is changing how we work, communicate, and receive information.

value.rationale: Both Iceland passages embed AI within defence of democracy and free speech, framing AI mainly as an enabler of disinformation; 2026 adds a call for faster international cooperation and notes AI's broad societal transformation.
